name: Mickey's Smokestack Baked Macaroni & Cheese & Sweet Potato Fries
whyItWorks: Soft elbow macaroni in cheddar cheese sauce is the safest comfort side at the BBQ counter—far gentler than collard greens, baked beans, or jalapeño cornbread.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pair the Baked Mac & Cheese with 1–2 Lactaid tablets and carved smoked turkey/chicken.
watchOuts: Frying oil on sweet potato fries
